stage5_protocol_lock.order: Thirty-five invariants passed before any Stage 5 public comparative run. WMT24 target outcomes were previously examined in Stage 4; this is an exploratory revision, not untouched external validation.
stage5_protocol_lock.raw_component: Published binary PPR, BetaBinomial(N,1,1) working prior
stage5_protocol_lock.prediction_component: Average of Stage 2 directional capital processes on exact count grid 0,...,N
stage5_protocol_lock.empty_handling: Use reserved-raw interval when the mixture accepted set is empty; do not intersect returned outputs after a repair
stage5_protocol_lock.guarantee: Nominal 95% anytime coverage; for each fixed w, tau_output(w) <= tau_PPR(delta*w) pathwise on the same uniform stream. No query noninferiority against raw 95%.
stage5_protocol_lock.scope: Aligned history: both leave-one-out and named-group holdout (65 folds). Artificial stresses: leave-one-out only (45 folds each). 155 case folds; 45 unique system/language targets.
stage5_protocol_lock.paired_design: Identical uniform query sequence for the same target across all methods, scenarios and holdout protocols. Repetitions across those comparisons are correlated.
stage5_protocol_lock.public_data: Same pinned WMT24 derived error-free binary scores as Stage 4. No new data, severity-weighted MQM or human annotation time claim.
stage5_protocol_lock.comparison: Primary: equally nominal 95% published PPR. Stricter reserved controls only verify the reserve guarantee. Other weights are prespecified diagnostic tradeoffs; no winner selection after results.
stage5_protocol_lock.novelty: Standard e-process mixture and confidence-set inclusion. Unresolved; prediction-powered anytime inference already exists.
stage5_protocol_lock.private_data: No private collaborative matrix, code or unpublished findings.

stage6_protocol_lock.note: Initial test-helper forwarding error corrected before freeze; all 18 invariants passed. Structural source checks preceded performance; no query-cost pilot was used to select the policy or allowance.
